reason: Project lens: src/render.6502 is hand-written (not in GENERATED), no PROTECT/PROTECT_BYTES range covers it (only irq1_handler, not_vsync_2ed0, wait_for_vsync_2242, moved_0004), not raster-timed. No data, table, zero page or workspace moves: the new code reads dm_typecol and writes dm_jmax exactly as the old did, with A/flags dead at jmax_done and after the chain (green starts STY/STY/BIT). Paging is unchanged (no new memory access, bank 4 code reading only the renderer's own variables). No label-offset entries into the region (grep for name +N on jmin_done/left_of_view/green/flipped/etc. finds none); not_right_of_view/jmax_done are referenced only here; the new block after BRA jmin_done is reachable only by the BNE. The old text occurs once. Bytes: +2 (BRA, BNE replaces BEQ) and -2 (the 3-compare chain of 12 bytes becomes CMP/BCS/AND/CMP/BEQ, 10), net 0, so .green and everything after keep their addresses and region room is untouched. Partition: with bit 7 set, green iff A>=&95 or (A AND &FD)==&85 i.e. A in {&85,&87}; same as old. Behaviour identical on every path (front end, helicopter, sky mode callers rely only on C at RTS, which this does not touch). Cycles: hot not_right_of_view -1; white -2, >=&95 -4, &87 -2, &85 +6 (never seen); claim of ~2.3 a draw consistent.
